title: Cardinal Billing Account Returned Payment Fee and Certified-Funds Schedule
content:
A payment returned unpaid by the bank or card issuer carries a returned-payment fee on the Cardinal Billing Account, and repeated returns restrict the account to certified funds. The figures are the same on every pay plan.

| Pay plan | Returned-payment fee | Returned payments that impose certified funds | Lookback (rolling months) | Certified-funds period (months from the latest return) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | $25.00 | 2 | 12 | 12 |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | $25.00 | 2 | 12 | 12 |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | $25.00 | 2 | 12 | 12 |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | $25.00 | 2 | 12 | 12 |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | $25.00 | 2 | 12 | 12 |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | $25.00 | 2 | 12 | 12 |

## Reading the schedule

- The fee of $25.00 is charged for each returned payment.
- Returned payments are counted over a rolling 12 calendar months.
- When the account reaches 2 returned payments within that lookback, only certified funds are accepted for 12 months from the latest return.

Hypothetical reading: an account with one returned payment in the last 12 months that has a second payment returned reaches 2 within the lookback, so the certified-funds period of 12 months runs from the date of that second return.
